chunks: Al-Husayn ibn ʿUbayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn ʿAbd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn ʿAmirah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said: A number of our companions narrated to me from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام.
He said: Seven buckets are to be drawn from it when a boy urinates into it, or a mouse falls into it, or something similar to it.

key_terms.يُنْزَحُ: water is to be drawn out

ai.seo_question: How many buckets must be drawn from a well if a boy urinates in it or a mouse falls into it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the purification of a well after contamination. It states that seven buckets of water are to be drawn from the well if a boy urinates in it or if a mouse or something similar falls into it.
